task.instruction: Find a recipe for a vegetarian lasagna under 600 calories per serving that has a prep time of less than 1 hour.

final_answer:
I found a recipe that meets all your criteria: **Artichoke Spinach Lasagna** from Allrecipes (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/).

**Why it fits:**
- **Vegetarian** — no meat; it's built on marinated artichoke hearts, frozen spinach, onions, garlic, and vegetable broth, layered with mozzarella and crumbled herb-and-garlic feta.
- **396 calories per serving** — comfortably under your 600-calorie limit (16g fat, 45g carbs, 21g protein per serving).
- **Prep time: 20 minutes** — well under 1 hour. (Cook time is 1 hr, for 1 hr 20 mins total, so plan for oven time.)

**Ratings:** 4.6 out of 5 from 1,824 ratings and 1,287 reviews; 2,169 home cooks report making it. It's tested by the Allrecipes Test Kitchen. Yields 8 servings.

**Ingredients:** cooking spray; 9 uncooked lasagna noodles; 1 chopped onion; 4 cloves chopped garlic; 1 (14.5 oz) can vegetable broth; 1 tbsp chopped fresh rosemary; 1 (14 oz) can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped; 1 (10 oz) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained and squeezed dry; 1 (28 oz) jar tomato pasta sauce; 3 cups shredded mozzarella (divided); 1 (4 oz) package herb and garlic feta, crumbled.

**Method in brief:** Preheat oven to 350°F and spray a 9x13-inch dish. Boil the noodles 8–10 minutes and drain. Sauté onion and garlic 3 minutes, add broth and rosemary and bring to a boil, then stir in artichokes and spinach and simmer covered 5 minutes; stir in the pasta sauce. Layer 1/4 of the mixture, 3 noodles, and 3/4 cup mozzarella, repeating twice more and finishing with the artichoke mixture and mozzarella; top with feta. Bake covered 40 minutes, uncovered 15 minutes more, then rest 10 minutes before cutting.

One note from reviewers: several found it a bit watery and suggest cutting back on the broth — the most helpful positive review (rated 4.75) recommends reducing it next time.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Artichoke Spinach Lasagna is vegetarian, prep 20 mins, and 396 calories per serving, satisfying all requested criteria.
